suggested_fix: Optional: exclude everything under <commonDir> except hooks/ from the project-root container, or accept only regular files outside .git.

problem: Ratchet coverage gaps: managed-hook.ts is not scanned, the guarded-fs-ops.ts allowlist entry does nothing, and .js / namespace lib/fs imports are missed
impact: A future raw write in managed-hook.ts or in a new src/gdskills module would pass CI with the ratchet green.

problem: copyDirectoryContained contains no containment check itself; a nested symlinked directory in the target aborts the install (fails closed, pre-existing)
impact: No escape. A cloned repo that ships a symlinked subdirectory under .metaproject/skills/... can make init/update abort (denial of service only).
